discovery.text: 42042-1.mpd|42042 - gearbox4.ldr|Compound gear reduction unit with 12, 16, and 20-tooth gears on multiple joined axles and a white beam frame.

references.title: Gear and axle module
references.lesson: Study gear stacks, axle joiners and the supports that register them to the surrounding gearbox.

operation.function: A gear-and-axle module in the crawler crane transmission.
operation.fixed: White crossbeam and bent support beams, once mounted in the parent gearbox.
operation.moving: Geared shafts, inline axle links and the separate elevated clutch gear.
operation.input: An exposed shaft driven by the parent gearbox; the isolated section does not identify a unique complete power path.
operation.output: Gear and axle interfaces to the surrounding transmission.
operation.parent_context: 42042 - gearbox.ldr supplies the rest of the multi-function gearbox and motor drive. The upper red clutch gear depends on that context.
operation.reuse_notes: Preserve gear positions, axle lengths, bushes and keyed orientations. Adapt the surrounding mounts and packaging first; retain the parent reference for exposed shafts.

discovery.text: 42042-1_Tower-Crane.mpd|42042 - spoolwormgear.ldr|Worm gear winch mechanism using a worm gear, 8-tooth gear, axles, and bent liftarms to drive a spool.

references.title: Worm-drive support module
references.lesson: Keep a worm shaft, its driven gear and retaining pieces together with their supporting layers.

operation.function: Worm-drive module for a tower-crane winding function.
operation.fixed: Liftarms and cross blocks provide the mounting structure.
operation.moving: Worm shaft and the separate axle carrying the eight-tooth gear.
operation.input: Axle carrying the worm gear, interpreted from the source arrangement.
operation.output: Eight-tooth gear axle; the winding drum and cable belong to the parent assembly.
operation.parent_context: 42042 - tower.ldr supplies the surrounding tower and remaining winding assembly.
operation.reuse_notes: Preserve the worm/gear placement, bush stack and the thin-beam layer. Copy the support geometry as a unit before designing a new external mount; no load-holding claim is made.

discovery.text: 9393-1.mpd|9393 - steering.ldr|Rack-and-pinion steering assembly using a gear rack, beam, and cross blocks to link the steering column to the wheels.

references.title: Steering rack carriage
references.lesson: A steering reference may contain the sliding rack and carrier while its driving pinion belongs to the parent.

operation.function: Rack carriage for the tractor steering system.
operation.fixed: Carrier beam and cross blocks provide the surrounding mounting arrangement.
operation.moving: Toothed rack and its associated steering connections; confirm the assembled relationships in the vehicle.
operation.input: Mating pinion supplied by 9393 - vehicle.ldr; no pinion is included in this extracted section.
operation.output: Lateral rack movement to the steering system, as interpreted from its intended role.
operation.parent_context: 9393 - vehicle.ldr supplies the driving gear, vehicle mounts and the remaining wheel-steering connections.
operation.reuse_notes: Treat this as a rack carriage, not a complete steering system. Include the matching pinion and parent supports when adapting it. Preserve the toothed side, axle stops and intended sliding space.

discovery.text: 42048-1.mpd|42048 - engine.ldr|A single-cylinder Technic engine with cylinder head, crankshaft, connecting rod, piston, and a 12-tooth drive gear.

references.title: Single-cylinder piston and crank
references.lesson: Use dedicated piston, connecting-rod, crankshaft and cylinder parts; read the source and per-step parts list for internals hidden within a grouped step.

operation.function: Display engine intended to turn shaft rotation into piston reciprocation.
operation.fixed: Cylinder and mounting cross blocks connect the engine to the chassis.
operation.moving: Crankshaft pieces, connecting rod and piston.
operation.input: External geared shaft connected to the parent kart drivetrain.
operation.output: Reciprocating piston visible at the cylinder opening; this is a display-engine role.
operation.parent_context: 42048 - Race Kart.ldr supplies the surrounding drivetrain and chassis mounting. The extracted cylinder is an embedded DAT definition and must travel with the assembly.
operation.reuse_notes: Keep the crank, rod and piston together and preserve their phase in the source pose. Retain the embedded cylinder definition and inspect the internal steps before mounting the complete engine.

discovery.text: 42083-1.mpd|42083 - frontaxlediff.ldr|Front axle differential unit with a 28-tooth bevel differential, 12-tooth bevel gears, and a 20-tooth bevel gear for drive distribution.

references.title: Differential in an axle frame
references.lesson: Inspect the internal bevel gear arrangement through the open carrier and source part list; preserve both axle outputs and their supports.

operation.function: Differential and drive gearing for the front axle of a car.
operation.fixed: Open rectangular frame and its beam mounts form the supporting structure.
operation.moving: Differential carrier, internal bevel gears, axle outputs and mating drive gears.
operation.input: Drive gear arrangement at the differential carrier, interpreted from source placement.
operation.output: Two axle shafts leading to the front-wheel drivetrain.
operation.parent_context: 42083 - frontaxle.ldr supplies the surrounding axle, wheel connections and chassis context.
operation.reuse_notes: Retain the differential internals, axle insertion depths and surrounding frame. Place the complete axle module first and adapt its exterior supports; input/output behavior has not been analytically verified.

discovery.text: 42068-1.mpd|42068 - turntable.ldr|Rotating turntable mechanism using a 28-tooth turntable pair driven by a 12-tooth bevel gear on an open-center beam base.

references.title: Geared turntable mount
references.lesson: Keep the two turntable halves, the driving gear and the base supports together while exposing the rotating attachment face.

operation.function: Geared rotating attachment in the rescue-vehicle assembly.
operation.fixed: Open-centre beam frame and the supported lower turntable half.
operation.moving: Driving gear shaft and the upper turntable half with its mounting ears.
operation.parent_context: 42068 - main.ldr supplies the external drive and attached structure.
operation.reuse_notes: Preserve the matching turntable halves and driving gear position. Attach the stationary base and moving upper assembly to different surrounding components; review their appearance in the intended pose.
